title: It’s a Sin vertical poster
slide_intent: Adapt title lettering to a tall format, because different placements require a new rhythm rather than a scaled copy.
strategic_value: Repeated condensed title fragments and saturated red/pink fields can give Channel 4’s drama a distinctive campaign voice while retaining the small green signature.
demonstration: A tall red poster stacks and repeats It’s a Sin lettering at changing scales around a central photographic strip; a green 4 and small season/date information appear at the top.
practical_value: Explore how repeated title fragments can organize a narrow poster while leaving room for a content image.

content_islands.name: Top attribution
content_islands.spec: Keep the green 4 and small release information above the main lettering.

content_islands.name: Type and image sequence
content_islands.spec: Stack oversized title fragments around the central image band, alternating pink and dark letters against red.

content_islands.name: Vertical frame
content_islands.spec: Retain the complete tall poster within the black surrounding field.
